Here’s why you’ll love working with us: - Stability & Growth: We’re 100% self-funded, with no outside investors or debt, meaning long-term stability and thoughtful growth. - People-First Culture: Our 95%+ employee retention rate reflects our commitment to competitive pay, respect, and career development. - Global Collaboration: Work with talented team members in the US and the Philippines who share your drive for excellence and impact. - Mission-Focused Work: Every role here supports organizations making the world a better place. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a difference, we’d love to hear from you! If you’re in the Philippines, have a knack software development, and are eager to drive growth for nonprofits, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of a team where your contributions have a lasting impact. hophr-hophr:lever:7680e537-2973-4b46-846.title: Chief of Staff to SVP
hophr-hophr:lever:7680e537-2973-4b46-846.description: Chief of Staff, Healthcare Analytics At CVS Health, our purpose is to simplify health care, one person, one family, and one community at a time, with the ambition to be America’s most trusted health care company. Healthcare Analytics powers that purpose, building AI-powered analytics solutions to help care reach consumers affordably and on time. This role is the right hand to the SVP leading Healthcare Analytics. You will own the numbers that keep the organization funded and accountable, the processes that keep it running day to day, and the communications that share its success stories with senior leadership and colleagues. This is a high-visibility seat for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of innovation, strategy, finance, and storytelling inside one of the largest analytics organizations in healthcare. What you will own Financial stewardship: manage the capital and operating budget across the portfolio, track value realization and ROI against committed initiatives, and build the financial narrative for budget reviews with business partners. Operational rhythm: run the recruiting pipeline, manage onboarding so new colleagues get up to speed effectively, organize leadership onsite workshops, and own meeting cadence to drive transparency and engagement. Executive communication: produce executive-ready materials, including leadership updates and other communications to represent the organization’s work with partners and stakeholders, both internal and external. This includes crafting the agenda and content for townhalls. Strategic planning and performance management support: partner on annual and mid-year planning cycles, including goal setting and tracking progress against commitments through scorecard and metrics updates. Talent management processes: run talent reviews and calibration, analyze Colleague Engagement survey results and drive the resulting action items, and support talent growth. Cross-functional coordination: serve as a connective point with peer Chiefs of Staff and the broader Digital, Data, Analytics and Technology organization to share best practices and coordinate updates. Issue resolution: identify and clear the blockers that slow initiatives down, escalating to the SVP as needed. What makes someone successful Genuine comfort with numbers, understanding what they mean for our scorecard and overall budget. Process discipline combined with creative solutioning and the instinct to build a system once rather than solve the same problem ad hoc every quarter. Strong executive presence in writing, knowing how to lead with key compelling messages and inspiring stories. High level understanding of AI to enable effective storytelling. Judgment about what needs the SVP’s attention and what can be handled independently. Comfort with ambiguity and change management, given all the exciting opportunities and disruption that AI is bringing to our field. Proficiency with (or eagerness to learn) using AI tools in their work to augment their role and provide support to the broader Healthcare Analytics leadership team. Required qualifications 10 years of total business experience, with a track record of managing budgets, building operational processes, and producing executive-level deliverables. Strong financial acumen, including experience tracking ROI or value realization on initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing structured processes such as recruiting pipelines, onboarding, or cross-functional meeting cadences. Excellent written communication skills, with examples of executive-ready materials produced with minimal senior leader input. Comfort operating in a fast-moving, matrixed organization without a dedicated team to delegate to. Familiarity with a product-oriented way of working, including how teams organize around products, ownership, and delivery. Healthcare or insurance industry experience preferred. Education Bachelor’s degree required. MBA or master’s degree in a quantitative or business field

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2a3a55b8-32b7-.title: Solutions Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2a3a55b8-32b7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Switzerland. This is a high-impact Solutions Architect opportunity focused on bringing cutting-edge Voice AI technology to Arabic-speaking markets. You will serve as a hands-on technical partner for enterprise customers, owning implementations from initial discovery through production deployment. The role combines customer-facing solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, technical delivery, and post-launch support. You will design solutions around real-world customer environments, technical constraints, and data-residency requirements while building reusable patterns that can accelerate future engagements. As the first dedicated technical presence for the region, you will also shape the regional playbook and influence product development through direct customer insights. The environment is fast-moving, AI-first, globally distributed, and highly collaborative, with significant autonomy and technical ownership. Own the technical design and delivery of enterprise customer implementations across the target region, from initial kickoff through production cutover and scaling. Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical evaluations for prospective customers in partnership with commercial teams. Design practical solutions that align with customer technology stacks, business requirements, operational constraints, and data-residency needs. Serve as a trusted technical advisor for Arabic-speaking customers, communicating effectively with both engineering teams and business or executive stakeholders. Represent the organization at customer meetings, industry events, and regional engagements, helping establish strong technical relationships. Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, deployment playbooks, and automation that can be applied across future customer projects. Translate lessons learned from implementations and evaluations into scalable technical approaches that shorten time to customer value. Bring customer feedback to Product and Research teams, particularly insights into Arabic-language model performance across different dialects and production use cases. Support complex post-onboarding technical cases and regional escalations, helping maintain strong customer outcomes as deployments scale. Contribute to expanding technical coverage across additional time zones as the global team grows. Balance customer delivery, pre-sales, technical enablement, documentation, product feedback, and escalations according to business priorities. Operate with an AI-first mindset, continuously experimenting with modern AI tools and incorporating them into technical discovery, development, solution design, and delivery workflows. Requirements Native or professional-level Arabic fluency combined with excellent written and spoken English. Based in the MENA region or elsewhere in EMEA, in a location where the relevant employment infrastructure supports hiring. At least 4 years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in a customer-facing technical role. Strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust , or a comparable language. Proven experience leading production technical deployments from solution design through implementation and cutover. Demonstrated ability to scope complex technical initiatives, break them into manageable stages, and drive successful delivery. Strong understanding of solution architecture, APIs, software development, system integration, and production deployment practices. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders

southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.title: Head of Supply Chain
southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.description: A jet engine has a few thousand parts that need to show up on time, to spec, and ready to build. Most companies take a decade to figure out how to do that. We are doing it differently. At Boom we are building Superpower — a natural gas turbine that fuels our endeavors while unblocking next-gen AI data centers. We are hiring a Head of Supply Chain to own everything from supplier qualification through delivery, and to build the organization that executes it. This is not a role for someone who manages spreadsheets and sends escalation emails. You will get on planes. You will walk shop floors. You will push suppliers harder than they thought possible and know exactly when they are managing you versus when they have a real problem. You have an engineering background and you use it every day. What you'll do: Own the entire supply chain organization — buyers, inventory, logistics, and forward deployed manufacturing engineers — and at least double it this year. Qualify and onboard suppliers across turbomachinery, mechanical systems, and structures. You are not inheriting a finished supply base — you are building it. Negotiate and manage supplier relationships across the full arc: scope, quote, kickoff, first article, production, and recovery when things slip. Structure contracts with incentives that drive the behavior you actually want — on-time delivery, quality, cost reduction. Not just terms that look good on paper. Inform and drive the make vs. buy conversation — bring the supplier data, cost analysis, and lead time reality that the rest of the organization needs to make the right call. Evaluate whether expanding into new geographic regions opens up capability, cost, or lead time advantages — and know how to qualify and manage suppliers in markets you haven't worked in before. Deploy forward deployed manufacturing engineers to critical suppliers and know when to go yourself. Set the standard for supplier performance. Define the metrics, run the reviews, and make the hard calls when a supplier isn't cutting it. Build the program infrastructure that gives the rest of the company real visibility into supply chain health — schedule, risk, and escalation — in an environment where that infrastructure doesn't fully exist yet. Work directly with the Build Engineer organization to close the loop between what gets designed and what can actually be built. Raise the bar on everyone around you. You probably have: An engineering background. You have designed or built something and that informs how you operate today. A track record of getting suppliers to do things they said couldn't be done. Experience building and scaling a team in a high-pressure environment. Scars from a program that was on fire and the instinct to run toward it, not away from it. You will thrive here if: You would rather get on a plane than send an email. You know the difference between a supplier who has a real problem and one who is making excuses — and you know what to do with both. You ask for forgiveness, not permission. We are not the right place for supply chain leaders who have spent their careers in a single lane at a large company. We are exactly the right place for someone who has been the most technically credible, most aggressive person in every room they've walked into — and wants to do that at a company building something that matters. Compensation The Base Salary Range for this position is $182,000 - $230,000 per year. Actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Boom’s total rewards package for employees. Other rewards may include long term incentives/equity, a flexible PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits. There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active. ITAR Requirement To conform to U.S. Government aerospace technology export regulations (I

The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service!
